# Rules

15 rules, 7 pending a check.

## Naming

### file-names

A file or directory is lowercase English, hyphens allowed, by `shape`.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `names`

### language-names

A source file in one of `underscored` joins words with an underscore.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `names`

### assigned-names

A name a tool assigns, one of `assigned`, is spelled the tool's way.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `names`

### no-claude-md

No CLAUDE.md exists anywhere in the tree.

- doc: [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)
- held by: check part `names`

### own-name

The project's own name appears only where a datum leaves the system and meets others'.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `names`

### vendor-name

A name in `vendors` appears only in a file the vendor defines, a dependency's package name, a declared adapter module, where a model declares its ground and drivers, or a rule's list of words.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: pending, owed: own-name's scan over `vendors`, and each repository's adapters declared in workspace.toml

### account-name

The author's account name, canmi21, appears in no identifier and no code that decides by it, only as data and in comments.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `identifiers`

### vendor-resources-drawn

Every resource a platform or an organization makes in a vendor account is named by an id drawn as monoflake/platform's RFC b8f35 draws one, 8 lowercase hex digits and bare, but for `handNamed`.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: pending, owed: each control's and CI's resource names in monoflake/cloud's controls.toml and systems.toml read against b8f35's form, `handNamed` excepted

### credential-names

A credential's variable, display and short forms name the same words, vendor first where it is tied to one, then the platform but never the foundation, then the purpose.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: check part `credentials`

### drawn-ids-once

A drawn id names one resource ever, never again once that resource is deleted; a replacement draws a new one.

- doc: [docs/naming.md](../../docs/naming.md)
- held by: pending, owed: a record of the names each account's deleted resources held, which nothing keeps yet, read against every drawn name in monoflake/cloud's configuration

### qualified-meanings

A module or a contract using both meanings of one word writes each by its qualified name.
